edge_type.none: the entity's scale has no predecessor for it (a root of its scale)
edge_type.successor: it follows its parent on the same axis (MTG '<')
edge_type.unknown: it has a parent, but the writer does not know how it follows it

kind.extensive: proportional to the amount of matter: summed when entities are merged, split by weights
kind.intensive: independent of the amount: averaged (weighted by volume or mass) when entities are merged
kind.massic_concentration: an amount per mass: averaged weighted by mass
kind.volumic_concentration: an amount per volume: averaged weighted by volume
kind.descriptor: not an amount: a position, an angle, a code, an order; not aggregated

role.state: computed and carried over time by the model
role.input: given to the model by another model or by forcings
role.parameter: a constant of the model, possibly per entity or per plant
role.derived: computed from other variables at each step, not carried over
role.setting: a choice of method or option, not a physical quantity

data_structure_kind.graph: entity sets per scale, with complex, parent and edge_type
data_structure_kind.regular_grid: a regular grid; its cells' ids are their C-order index
data_structure_kind.adaptive_grid: an adaptive grid; its leaf cells carry level and index

grid_kind.regular: shape cells of size spacing from origin
grid_kind.adaptive: a regular base grid refined up to maxLevel; the leaf cells are listed

scale.mixed: an entity set whose rows belong to several base scales (e.g. CPlantBox's organs: root axes and leaves)

bearer_relation.successor: MTG '<' to an entity of another scale
bearer_relation.branch: MTG '+' to an entity of another scale
bearer_relation.decomposition: MTG '/' to an entity that is not its complex
